verdict.rationale: A live probe confirmed Epic serves llms.txt on both www.unrealengine.com and dev.epicgames.com. However, the CDN intermittently returns HTTP 403 WAF challenges to curl, node, and python clients, so agents without a browser-grade client cannot rely on it. Appending .md to docs URLs returns the HTML SPA shell rather than markdown, though the Python API reference and the Remote Control and automation docs are fetchable keylessly as HTML. Missing for 10: reliable non-browser access to llms.txt, markdown or agent-formatted doc variants, evidence of llms.txt depth and coverage, first-party docs describing the agent-oriented surface.
